name: MOLA Topographic Elevation
description: Mars Orbiter Laser Altimeter digital elevation model. Provides global topographic data at 128 pixels per degree (~463 m/px). The data reveals the dramatic elevation range of Mars from the Hellas basin to Olympus Mons.

name: HiRISE Jezero Crater Imagery
description: High Resolution Imaging Science Experiment imagery of the Jezero Crater region. HiRISE captures the highest resolution imagery of Mars from orbit at 25–50 cm per pixel.

name: CRISM Mineralogy — Jezero
description: Compact Reconnaissance Imaging Spectrometer for Mars (CRISM) mineral mapping for the Jezero Crater region. Identifies clay minerals, carbonates, and iron oxides indicative of past water activity.

name: MCS Thermal Infrared
description: Mars Climate Sounder thermal infrared mapping. Surface temperature variations reveal thermal inertia patterns linked to rock type and dust coverage. Useful for identifying rocky vs. sandy terrain.
